timing: Sequential independent Python processes; all solvers compiled/imported on development seed 72000 outside timing. Each sample is a fresh full API call, including validation, quantization, CSR assembly and allocations. Method order shuffled independently each round; map/cap order shuffled per process. Verification outside timed intervals. No result/topology cache.
eligibility: Both methods must return the certified feasible optimum on every one of 21 repeats per case. All statuses, costs, routes and times retained. Independently check every repeat with the Bellman certificate.
primary_estimator: Geometric mean baseline/candidate ratios of within-process 7-call medians, equally weighting exact pairs and the 3 processes.
primary_rule: Confirm average speed advantage over compiled lazy A* only if the lower endpoint of the preregistered approximate hierarchical 95% bootstrap interval exceeds 1; 20000 draws, RNG502999, resample whole process sessions globally and whole map-seed blocks with families/caps retained.
secondary_analysis: Bonferroni approximate simultaneous 95% intervals across 6 comparators; all-method common-success support and family breakdowns. No tuning in response to these results.
reporting: Report exact-solve coverage, unresolved and capped cases, worst route gaps, each process ratio, and every loss. Do not substitute another primary comparator after results are opened.
scope: Positive quantized estimated costs with one static discrete resource on one host; no universal solver, physical survival, embedded-cycle or per-component novelty claim.
limits: Three process sessions are not three independent machines.
Bootstrap inference is approximate with limited clusters.
Success-conditioned timing is not all-case superiority.
Single deadline per map; public realistic-network and component-ablation coverage remain incomplete.
